Why there are two addresses

Every subdomain in the zone answers at /<slug>/, because that is what gets typed and what gets pasted into a message. Artist records are grouped under /artists/ so the roster reads as a roster. This page points at the canonical one and carries the same address in its <link rel="canonical">, so search engines settle on a single answer.
